# Bundled fonts (Events cards)

Used only by the Events card renderer (`ui/events/EventFonts.kt`). Files live in `app/src/main/assets/fonts/`.
They were downloaded from https://github.com/google/fonts and subset to Latin (Basic Latin, Latin-1, common punctuation) with fontTools to save space.
Variable fonts keep their weight axis only (other axes pinned; Roboto Flex is pinned to its widest width, used as "Roboto Wide").

| id | Family | Licence | Source |
|----|--------|---------|--------|
| inter | Inter | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter |
| quicksand | Quicksand | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/quicksand |
| roboto-condensed | Roboto Condensed | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotocondensed |
| roboto-mono | Roboto Mono | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotomono |
| roboto-slab | Roboto Slab | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/apache/robotoslab |
| roboto-wide | Roboto Flex (wide instance) | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotoflex |
| baskerville | Libre Baskerville | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/librebaskerville |
| gloock | Gloock | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/gloock |
| merienda | Merienda | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/merienda |
| marker | Permanent Marker | Apache 2.0 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/apache/permanentmarker |
